{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
data['biomarker_final'] = data['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute the response rate by sex
crosstab = pd.crosstab(data['sex'], data['responded'], normalize='index') * 100
crosstab = crosstab.round(2)

# Extract response rates
female_response_rate = crosstab.loc['F', 1]
male_response_rate = crosstab.loc['M', 1]

difference = female_response_rate - male_response_rate

difference"}
